nl.title: Twee-factorauthenticatie (2FA) inschakelen in CyberPanel
nl.excerpt: Twee-factorauthenticatie (2FA) inschakelen in CyberPanel: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
Twee-factorauthenticatie (2FA) in CyberPanel beperkt schade als een wachtwoord uitlekt. Activeer dit vooral op admin-accounts.

Stappen

  1. Log in op CyberPanel.
  2. Open je gebruikers-/beveiligingsinstellingen (2FA / TOTP).
  3. Scan de QR-code met een authenticator-app.
  4. Sla backupcodes veilig op (wachtwoordmanager).
  5. Test een keer uitloggen en opnieuw inloggen met 2FA.

Tip: Zonder backupcodes kun je jezelf buitensluiten — bewaar ze offline of in een kluis.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: Wachtwoord resetten; panel bereikbaar houden op 8090.

en.title: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) in CyberPanel
en.excerpt: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) in CyberPanel: steps in CyberPanel for two, factor, authentication.
en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) in CyberPanel. You work in CyberPanel, focusing on two, factor, authentication — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to CyberPanel
  • Focus of this article: two, factor, authentication
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Start in CyberPanel. Before clicking, note the current value for two, factor, authentication.
  2. Select the correct website in CyberPanel.
  3. Open SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager or Backup — focused on two.
  4. Apply the factor update; purge OLS cache if the site shows stale content.
  5. Check Error Logs if you get 500/white screen after the change.
  6. Rotate credentials tied to two, factor, authentication if abuse was possible.
  7. Schedule monitoring or a follow-up check.

Verify

  • Result for two, factor, authentication matches “Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) in CyberPanel”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside two factor authentication
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get two, factor, authentication right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if two, factor, authentication touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: CyberPanel, backups, tickets.
